description: This source file defines React components related to exporting chat messages. It includes UI components for selecting export options, rendering previews in different formats (text, image, json), and handling export actions such as copy, download, and share. It utilizes various hooks, dynamic imports, and external utilities to implement export functionalities in a chat application.

classes.name: ExportMessageModal
classes.description: A modal component for exporting messages, wrapping MessageExporter.

classes.name: MessageExporter
classes.description: Main component facilitating message export options, preview, and configuration.

classes.name: RenderExport
classes.description: Component to render message content into a hidden container for image export.

classes.name: PreviewActions
classes.description: UI actions for copying, downloading, and sharing exported messages.

classes.name: ImagePreviewer
classes.description: Component for previewing chat messages as images with export options.

classes.name: MarkdownPreviewer
classes.description: Component to display messages as markdown and facilitate export.

classes.name: JsonPreviewer
classes.description: Component to display messages as JSON with export options.

methods.name: preview
methods.description: Returns the appropriate preview component based on selected format.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies the provided data to clipboard.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Triggers download of the message content in selected format.

methods.name: refreshPreview
methods.description: Refreshes the image preview by resetting DOM innerHTML.
